items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Because they wanted me, because Leonard Harper had spoke to me about playing this show on Broadway.

ctx.x: know you'd made all those great records in Chicago. But when Connie's Inn and the 'Hot Chocolates' records, 'Aint Misbehaving' that seemed as though from that time on he seemed to be accelerating a bit. Commercially I think.

Of course they wanted me to play the show on Broadway, Hot Chocolates. But Louis said no, he wanted me to stay to take care of the band at the Inn. See, so I got cut out of that. Because they really, the producer Leonard Harper and all, they wanted me to play that show on Broadway. See, 'Aint Misbehaving' where, ............

And Now I can tell it the way Louis told Lucille you know when Zutty never worked with Louis any more you know and he never got Zutty in the band. And Lucille told me when we were out there spending the four days with her and she and I were downstairs talking you know. And she said, well you know to tell you the truth, Margie, why Zutty never, Louis never got Zutty (unintelligible), he told me once that he wasn't going to have Zutty take another band away from him. I said, now what do you mean? I said now what do…
